hints.title: Full Tetrahedral Pyramids
hints.text: A full triangular pyramid of height h holds h * (h + 1) * (h + 2) / 6 boxes and has h * (h + 1) / 2 floor boxes.

hints.title: Find Largest Full Pyramid
hints.text: Determine the largest height h such that the full tetrahedral pyramid does not exceed n.

hints.title: Distribute Remaining Boxes
hints.text: For the remaining boxes, each additional floor box j supports up to j extra boxes. Find min j such that j * (j + 1) / 2 >= rem.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumBoxes(self, n: int) -> int:
        curr = 0
        h = 0
        while curr + (h + 1) * (h + 2) // 2 <= n:
            h += 1
            curr += h * (h + 1) // 2

        floor_boxes = h * (h + 1) // 2
        rem = n - curr
        j = 0
        while rem > 0:
            j += 1
            rem -= j
            floor_boxes += 1
        return floor_boxes
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating block placement box-by-box takes O(n) time, exceeding limits for n = 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tetrahedral geometry reduces problem to cubic root arithmetic progression search in O(n^(1/3)) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate models corner stacking as a tetrahedral pyramid plus triangular layer increments.
